storyCards.headline: The Power: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Snap!'s "The Power" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "The Power" is a song by German Eurodance group Snap.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

The Power was released in 1990.
